listing.name: Core World systems rework
listing.summary: As continuation of my previous mod Procgen Overhaul, I attempted to rework every system in the Core Worlds to be wider, feature more cover and possibly feel a bit more creative in terms of what appears in them. This took a lot of work, and is still not necessarily done.
listing.aiSummary: Reworks Core World systems to be wider with more cover and varied features.

description:
Screenshots:

Spoiler

Explanation:

Spoiler
As continuation of my previous mod Procgen Overhaul, I attempted to rework every system in the Core Worlds to be wider, feature more cover and possibly feel a bit more creative in terms of what appears in them. This took a lot of work, and is still not necessarily done. There are 4 systems left to rework for me. But I have reworked most of them across the years. Granted, the reason it took so long was because this used to be a part of a much larger rework mod, but that idea got salvaged with this being one of the many leftovers after it

Disclaimer:
- I haven't extensively tested this mod in this state in the current version of the game, but it seems functional. I did extensively test it in the previous versions of the game and there were no crashes
- This does not disrupt the newly added Sindrian Diktat quest seemingly as it does not require for the system scripts to be unchanged
- This will disrupt mods that override the systems themselves, such as Knights of Ludd, as it will conflict with this mod's overwrite

Download link:
https://github.com/Limieczeczerz/Procgen-Fix/releases/download/Starsector/New.Systems.B.zip

edit: sry, the mod version accidentally had 0.98 written on it, when it was just tested with 0.98.5, it's fixed now

edit2: put Yma, Hybrasil and Valhalla into unused files, will work on them later, as of now they feel unfinished
